notes: Donya-e-Eqtesad (Iran, Persian). robots.txt 200 and permissive: disallows only /fa|en|ar/admin/*, /admin/*, '*:id*', *.asp, /newsstudios/*, and names 'Sitemap: https://donya-e-eqtesad.com/sitemap.xml'. That index (200, 191 KB) is a <sitemapindex> of 979 entries whose <loc> paths are base64url (unpadded) JSON query descriptors, e.g. /sitemap/eyJtb2RlbCI6Im5ld3NzdHVkaW9QYWdlIiwicGFnZSI6OTc1LCJwZXJQYWdlIjoyMDAwfQ,,.xml decoding to {"model":"newsstudioPage","page":975,"perPage":2000}. 879 of them are newsstudioPage, 99 other models, 1 menu. Each newsstudioPage <loc> returns a flat <urlset> of up to 2000 article URLs each with a per-URL <lastmod>; pages run oldest->newest (page 1 = 2006), so the newest page is a short remainder (389 URLs on 2026-10-27). Route: read the index for the highest page number, then walk page numbers downward, keeping URLs whose <lastmod> date is in 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, stopping when a page's newest lastmod is older than the window start. 6 requests total (index + pages 978..973), about 60-90 s at polite_fetch's 1-2 req/s. Wrote 6634 unique URLs, 31/31 days (09-30=214, 10-10=246, 10-20=230, min day 10-15=129). Date source: <lastmod> IS the publication time on this site, verified on 6 article re-fetches from the three target days - the page JSON-LD "datePublished" equalled the sitemap <lastmod> to the second (e.g. 2026-09-30T00:10:28Z, 2026-10-10T20:30:00Z, 2026-10-20T17:40:25Z), all 200, 5.4k-9.8k chars of text, never more than 0 days from the listed date. The sitemap <loc> values mix RAW UTF-8 Persian with percent-encoded bytes, which urllib rejects ('ascii codec can't encode') as status 0; the script percent-quotes each path with safe='%/:?&=#' so existing escapes are not double-encoded - this was the only real trap on this outlet. No WAF, no 403/429, no GDELT/CDX fallback needed; the site's own sitemap covers the whole window in one short walk. Fallback if /sitemap.xml ever fails: binary-search the highest page number that still returns <url> (implemented in the script).
